title: Formulary Benefit Biosimilar Transition Note: Dose Cycles Supplied on a Move to a Preferred Biosimilar
content:
On the Formulary Benefit, a member's specialty transition supply may come during a move to a preferred biosimilar. In that case the number of dose cycles the supply covers depends on two things: whether the formulary prefers interchangeable biosimilars, and what the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program records about the drug.

**Clause.** The number of dose cycles that a specialty transition supply covers is set as follows:

- **(a)** The formulary prefers interchangeable biosimilars, the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program pairs the drug with a preferred biosimilar, and that program pays a biosimilar switch waiver (a switch waiver of more than zero months). The supply covers **1** dose cycle.
- **(b)** The formulary prefers interchangeable biosimilars, and the program pairs the drug with a preferred biosimilar but pays no switch waiver (a switch waiver of zero months). The supply covers **2** dose cycles.
- **(c)** In every other case, the supply covers as many dose cycles as the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug contained, which is that fill's quantity.

The supply's days are the number of dose cycles multiplied by the length of one dose cycle, that is, the latest shipped fill's days supply divided by its quantity.

**Which formularies prefer interchangeable biosimilars.** The Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary and Northbridge Preferred Drug List do. The Northbridge Broad Formulary and Northbridge Open Formulary do not.

## Condition grid

| Formulary prefers biosimilars | Program pairs the drug with a preferred biosimilar | Program's switch waiver | Dose cycles |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | more than zero months | 1 |
| yes | yes | zero months | 2 |
| yes | no | any | quantity of the latest shipped fill |
| no | any | any | quantity of the latest shipped fill |

*Hypothetical.* Suppose the latest shipped fill of a biologic was 28 days with quantity 2, so one dose cycle is 14 days. On the Northbridge Value Formulary, with the drug paired and a waiver of 3 months, the supply covers 1 cycle, which is 14 days. With the same pairing and no waiver it covers 2 cycles, which is 28 days. On the Northbridge Broad Formulary it covers 2 cycles, the fill's quantity.
